audience: email and SMS marketers who manage lists, profiles and flows in Klaviyo

useCases.title: Review campaigns and flows
useCases.text: List the campaigns and the automation flows with their status. Open one campaign to read its send time and audience.

useCases.title: Check the profiles in a list
useCases.text: List the lists with their creation dates. Then list the profiles that belong to one list.

useCases.title: Find a contact and its properties
useCases.text: Filter profiles by email address, then open one profile to read its attributes and properties.

useCases.title: Build a list of selected customers
useCases.text: Create an empty list, then add existing profiles to it by id, up to 100 per call. Adding a profile can start flows.

useCases.title: Add a new contact or correct one
useCases.text: Create a profile from an email address, phone number or name. It does not subscribe the contact to marketing. Update the fields of an existing profile.
